---
title: "Joshua"
---

# Joshua

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Joshua records Israel's conquest and settlement of the Promised Land, demonstrating that God faithfully fulfills His promises. The book teaches that victory comes through trusting and obeying the Lord.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 1:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Be strong and courageous</div>

### Why This Verse

Most famous verse in Joshua

### Chapter Insight

This chapter commissions Joshua to lead Israel into the Promised Land. The key verse emphasizes courage grounded in God's presence and promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 2:11</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD your God is God</div>

### Why This Verse

Rahab's confession of faith

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Rahab's protection of the spies. The key verse highlights faith that recognizes God's sovereignty.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 3:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Sanctify yourselves</div>

### Why This Verse

Preparation for crossing Jordan

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes Israel's crossing of the Jordan River. The key verse demonstrates God's power and presence leading His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 4:24</div>

<div class="identifier">That all peoples may know the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Purpose of the memorial stones

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes memorial stones to remember God's faithfulness. The key verse emphasizes passing God's works to future generations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 5:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Captain of the LORD's host</div>

### Why This Verse

Significant theophany passage

### Chapter Insight

This chapter marks Israel's renewal through circumcision and Passover. The key verse reveals God's removal of Israel's reproach and preparation for conquest.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 6:20</div>

<div class="identifier">The wall fell down flat</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous Jericho victory verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the fall of Jericho. The key verse highlights victory through obedience rather than human strength.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 7:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Israel hath sinned</div>

### Why This Verse

Explanation of Israel's defeat

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Achan's sin and Israel's defeat at Ai. The key verse demonstrates how hidden sin affects the entire community.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 8:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear not, neither be dismayed</div>

### Why This Verse

Restoration after failure

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Israel's victory at Ai and covenant renewal. The key verse emphasizes obedience as the path to success.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 9:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

Lesson from the Gibeonite deception

### Chapter Insight

This chapter tells of the Gibeonites' deception. The key verse illustrates the danger of making decisions without seeking God's counsel.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 10:13</div>

<div class="identifier">The sun stood still</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the Bible's best-known miracles

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records God's miraculous intervention in battle. The key verse highlights God's power fighting on behalf of His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 11:15</div>

<div class="identifier">Joshua left nothing undone</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of Joshua's obedience

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the defeat of northern Canaanite kings. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 12:24</div>

<div class="identifier">Thirty-one kings in all</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of conquest victories

### Chapter Insight

This chapter summarizes Israel's military victories. The key verse reflects God's complete victory over opposing kings.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 13:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou art old and stricken in years</div>

### Why This Verse

Transition to land distribution

### Chapter Insight

This chapter begins the division of the land among the tribes. The key verse reminds Joshua that God's work continues despite his age.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 14:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Give me this mountain</div>

### Why This Verse

Caleb's famous request

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Caleb's request for his inheritance. The key verse highlights steadfast faith after decades of waiting.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 15:19</div>

<div class="identifier">Give me a blessing</div>

### Why This Verse

Achsah's request for springs

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details Judah's inheritance. The key verse emphasizes the fulfillment of God's promise to Caleb.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 16:10</div>

<div class="identifier">They did not drive out the Canaanites</div>

### Why This Verse

Foreshadows future problems

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the inheritance of Ephraim. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness in distributing the land.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 17:18</div>

<div class="identifier">Thou shalt drive out the Canaanites</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to faith and action

### Chapter Insight

This chapter details the inheritance of Manasseh. The key verse demonstrates faith in claiming God's promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 18:3</div>

<div class="identifier">How long are ye slack to possess the land?</div>

### Why This Verse

Challenge to incomplete obedience

### Chapter Insight

This chapter continues the distribution of the land. The key verse challenges Israel to fully possess what God has given.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 19:49</div>

<div class="identifier">They made an inheritance for Joshua</div>

### Why This Verse

Joshua receives his portion

### Chapter Insight

This chapter completes the tribal inheritances. The key verse demonstrates God's faithfulness to all the tribes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 20:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Cities of refuge</div>

### Why This Verse

Purpose statement for refuge cities

### Chapter Insight

This chapter establishes the cities of refuge. The key verse reveals God's provision of justice and mercy.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 21:45</div>

<div class="identifier">Not one promise failed</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Joshua's most quoted verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter assigns cities to the Levites. The key verse celebrates God's complete fulfillment of His promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 22:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Love the LORD and walk in His ways</div>

### Why This Verse

Covenant exhortation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the eastern tribes' return home. The key verse emphasizes unity and faithfulness within God's people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 23:14</div>

<div class="identifier">Not one thing hath failed</div>

### Why This Verse

Joshua's farewell testimony

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains Joshua's farewell exhortation. The key verse calls Israel to remain devoted to God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Joshua 24:15</div>

<div class="identifier">As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most cited verses in Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes with covenant renewal at Shechem. The key verse challenges God's people to choose whom they will serve.
:::
